lines: Lanka Divyabharathi, Promoter Group, sold in an offer for sale through the stock exchange; the seller's own share count and proceeds are unknown.
The notice prints Up to 38,10,000 Equity Shares for all sellers together, not this seller's own shares, so the amount is unknown.
The trigger is old: the sale settled on 21 Apr 2026, 207 days ago, so proceeds are not a current event.
Confidence is medium: the name was verified in the seller list, but it appears in one section of the notice only.
